as_told.title: Gifted programs as a funnel into psi programs

plain: Michels suggests that American gifted-and-talented school programmes have served as a funnel, the first stage for spotting children who are later steered into deeper, secret programmes that train psychic abilities. On one episode he offers this as his own idea, and on others he credits it to Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he helped retrieve a UFO and has spoken about these programmes publicly, and to people named Jordan Jose and Julia Mosbury. If true, it would mean ordinary schools quietly fed recruits into psychic research.
